mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, light rain. Next 24 hours: high 10, low 7.

Chelsea defender Maxence Lacroix has suffered a serious thigh muscle injury and is expected to miss up to ten matches, leaving the club without its key centre-back for an extended period.

Albanian professional soldiers are rejecting a new defence-ministry proposal on post-45-year service status and have warned they will stage a protest on 7 November.

The Swiss National Bank reported a profit of 44.2 billion Swiss francs for the January-September 2026 period, driven mainly by strong foreign-exchange investment returns.

European Union foreign-policy chief Kaja Kallas warned that Russia continues to employ Soviet-era tactics in its approach to the West, urging member states to remain vigilant.

Albania's Supreme Court annulled the fire verdict for the 2021 Tetovo modular hospital tragedy, citing procedural flaws and sending the case back for a new trial.
